title: Boston Developer Week — Vendor Contacts & Receipt Playbook
content:
Quick personal playbook for Boston Developer Week (BDW) logistics, vendors, and receipts. Use this when chasing invoices, filing expenses, and prepping hardware shipments. Mostly a working scratchpad — keep it messy.

OVERVIEW:
- Conference dates: Mar 31–Apr 2, 2026. Travel days Mar 30 (arrive) and Apr 3 (depart).
- Role: onsite demo lead + vendor coordinator (booth #C12). Bringing 2 demo laptops, 1 edge device.
- Primary goals: ensure vendor invoices are cleared by finance before Apr 10 cutoff; collect team receipts daily for per-diem reconciliation; confirm AV and furniture delivery windows.

KEY DATES / DEADLINES: (ordered)
- Mar 10: final headcount to venue + badge list (DONE).
- Mar 17: last day to confirm AV changes with Skyline AV (paid invoices required).
- Mar 24: FedEx outbound label created for hardware return (to Redwood HQ receiving).
- Apr 6: last day to submit travel expenses for April payroll cycle.

VENDORS & CONTACTS (save in phone / Slack DM):
- Skyline AV — primary AV: contact Aaron Lee, aaron@skylineav.com, +1 617-555-3910. Invoice code: EVT-AV-03-BDW. Notes: confirm mic stash and HDMI adapters.
- Booth Carpentry / Furnishings — FittedEvents Inc., contact: Maria Torres, maria@fittedevents.io, +1 617-555-8822. PO sent on Mar 2. Invoice expected net-30. PO#: PO-54821.
- Catering (booth snacks & water) — LocalBites Catering, contact: Omar Khan, omar@localbites.co, +1 617-555-2099. Expense category: meals/booth. Per receipt: itemize coffee, bottled water, snacks.
- FedEx Logistics pickup — Redwood vendor account: ACCT-987654. Contact: FedEx depot Charlestown, shifts: 10a–2p pickup window. Tracking prefix: 6123.
- Onsite security badge pass — Venue Security Ops: security@bostoncvb.org. Provide list of booth staff and temporary passes.

EXPENSE PROCESS NOTES (Finance reminders):
- Redwood expense system prefers one digital receipt per bank card charge. For local vendors that give handwritten receipts, scan with phone, upload into Expensify, tag with code EVT-BDW-26.
- For team meals split across cards: keep an itemized bill and submit one card's charge with 'split meal' note + names. Finance prefers itemized for corporate card charges > $75.
- Per-diem guidance: domestic per-diem set at $65/day for Boston area. Use per-diem code TRV-PD-US. No receipts required for per-diem but add headcount in the expense entry.
- Vendor invoices: ask for PDF invoices and W9 for any contractor > $600. Send to finance AP team at ap@redwood.ai with subject line "BDW vendor invoice — [vendor name]". If invoice is missing PO#, include PO#: PO-54821 or note to create.

RECEIPT CAPTURE CHECKLIST (daily):
- Day 0 (travel day): taxi/Uber receipts, boarding passes (pdf), hotel folio (capture final folio at checkout).
- Day 1–3 (onsite): all vendor receipts (catering, AV incidentals), team coffees (if on company card), tolls/parking.
- Day 4 (return): shipping receipt for outbound FedEx + any customs forms.
- Upload order: 1) scan/photo, 2) add date, vendor, amount, expense code, 3) tag with "BDW-2026", 4) submit batch to Expensify.

SAMPLE EMAIL TO REQUEST INVOICE FROM VENDOR (copy/paste):
Hi [Vendor Contact],

Thanks again for supporting Redwood at Boston Developer Week. Could you please send a PDF invoice for the services provided (include PO# PO-54821 where applicable) and a W9 if you’re a new vendor? Our AP team needs the invoice by Mar 31 to process payment in the April cycle. Send to ap@redwood.ai and CC me (maya@redwood.ai).

Best,
Maya Patel

TRAVEL & LOGISTICS NOTES (hardware handling):
- Packing list: 2x MacBook Pros (in hard sleeves), 1x Jetson edge device (foam), 1x power strip, 3x HDMI adapters, misc cables, toolkit (screwdriver, zip ties), spare battery pack. Mark each device with red tape and serials in the equipment sheet.
- Shipping label return address: Redwood HQ Receiving, 120 Harbor Street, Building 5, Receiving Dock B, Boston, MA 02110. Attn: Maya Patel.
- Customs/international note: if any demo kit comes from EU office, include ATA carnets or commercial invoice; FedEx requires customs invoice scanned into vendor folder.

ONSITE DAILY RUNNING SHEET (short form for booth lead):
- 8:00 am — set up begins (AV arrival window: 8–9a).
- 9:30 am — final lights check, mic test.
- 10:00 am — booth open, staff rota: Maya 10–2, Jonah 2–6, Priya 11–3.
- 1:00 pm — midday restock of snacks and water (confirm with Omar).
- 4:30 pm — demo team sync (quick notes on issues for night pickup).
- 6:30 pm — teardown briefing (confirm FedEx pickup for return labels next day).

REIMBURSEMENT CODES (Finance mapping quick reference):
- Travel airfare: TRV-AIR
- Hotel: TRV-LODG
- Meals (card): TRV-MEAL
- Per-diem: TRV-PD-US
- Vendor AV/invoice: EVT-AV-03-BDW
- Booth furniture: EVT-FURN-03

TROUBLESHOOTING / EDGE CASES:
- If vendor only gives cash receipt (no business name), ask for a short email from the vendor confirming service and amount; attach both to expense.
- Lost receipt: fill out lost receipt affidavit (simple note in expense entry, manager approval required).
- Late invoice after Apr 6 payroll window: tag as "April adj" and escalate to AP manager (Kelsey Tran). Expect payment in next cycle.

PERSONAL NOTES / TO-DOS: (scratch items)
- Confirm HDMI-to-DisplayPort adapter count (I think we have 2 spares in kit).
- Grab extra name badge lanyards from office supply closet.
- Print 25 small Redwood one-sheet QR cards (quick link to demo).
- Remind Jonah to upload demo code snapshot to GH release branch before travel. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/demo-apps/tree/bdw-2026

AFTER-ACTION (post-conference checklist):
- Day +1: confirm all FedEx returns delivered, collect tracking #s, attach to expense.
- Day +3: reconcile team receipts, submit per-person expense batches, confirm manager approvals.
- Day +10: follow up on any outstanding vendor invoices; escalate if >30 days.

NOTES TO SELF (random):
- Bring a small collapsible charger — easier to keep near booth.
- Keep a printed copy of this doc in binder in case phone dies.
- If anything goes sideways, escalate in #events-boston-2026 Slack channel and ping @events-ops.

END — will tidy up into a formal vendor packet if team wants a handout. For now: live, messy, functional.
